firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone,

I am looking to join a team for the ARC Prize 2026. 
I am not a coder, but I offer a high-concept, low-entropy semantic reasoning style. 
My approach focused entirely on core knowledge priors: topology, negative space, and object boundaries.

I have passed some ARC-AGI-3 games 100% without loss (I saved the Json and also the replay), and I can translate the solving steps to logic.

What I bring to the team:

Cognitive Diversity: My reasoning style is rooted in a non-English, highly structured language system (Hungarian). This naturally allows for unique spatial analogies and abstract structural leaps that standard English-trained LLMs often miss.

Noise-Free Abstraction: I can rapidly identify the fundamental rules of a grid, saving you hours of brute-force trial and error.

What I am looking for:
A Python developer who can translate these high-level human heuristics into executable code or ARC-DSL.
Let’s team up, combine our strengths, and bridge the gap between human intuition and machine code!

Feel free to reach out via PM if you want to test a few puzzles together..
